meta.title: Process — BeeCreative
meta.description: How BeeCreative works: four steps from the first conversation to a live website — discovery, design, build and launch.

hero.description: Four steps from the first conversation to a live website. No magic — just a craft repeated enough times to make it look easy.

discovery.name: Discovery
discovery.title: Discover
discovery.subtitle: / strategy
discovery.description: Before we take off, we study the map. We get inside your business: who your customers are, what gets in their way and where your competitors stand. The better we understand the landscape, the more precise the outcome.
tasks: Interviews with you and your team
discovery.result: a strategic document, week-by-week plan and clear proposal — no fine print.

dance.name: Dance
dance.title: Design
dance.subtitle: / prototype
dance.description: A bee shows direction through dance — we use a prototype. You see how the website will look and feel before we write a line of production code. Changes are inexpensive here; later they aren't.
dance.result: an approved design and prototype you can try directly on your phone.

build.name: Build
build.title: Build
build.subtitle: / cell by cell
build.description: Code is written in sprints, not behind closed doors. Every week you see a working version in staging — no slide decks, just the real website in a real browser.
build.result: a staging environment that grows every week, backed by code we're proud to show.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.title: Launch
harvest.subtitle: / growth
harvest.description: Launch isn't the finish line — it's day one. We move everything into production, train your team and stay close afterwards. Honey is harvested regularly, not just once.
harvest.result: a live website, full access to everything and 30 days of fixes on us.

principles.title: Three rules,
principles.description: The process is half the work. The other half is how you feel while we're doing it.

visibility.title: You see everything
visibility.description: Weekly demos of the working website, not slide decks. Progress is seen in the browser, not described in meetings.

singleContact.title: One point of contact
singleContact.description: You talk to one person who knows your entire project — no bouncing between departments.

noSurprises.title: No surprises
noSurprises.description: Clear scope and clear pricing. Changes are discussed before they cost you — not afterwards.
